info.name: EPP 第三十七章 旧记录保持

exec: pm.test("不返回凭据字段", () => { const keys = []; const visit = x => { if (x && typeof x === "object") { for (const [k,v] of Object.entries(x)) { keys.push(k); visit(v); } } }; visit(pm.response.json()); pm.expect(keys.some(k => ["passwordHash", "password_hash", "passwordCredential"].includes(k))).to.eql(false); });
